title: 第4章 时间之塔

content_zh:
萧阳和罗梅兰坐在大厅中，担忧看向紧闭的房门。自从萧叶从村长家返回后，已经把自己关在房间一个时辰了。
“唉，叶儿看似坚强，但是这件事情带给他的伤害太大了。”萧阳说道。
萧叶对柳依依的情感，他这个做爹的很清楚。
“阳哥，我们的儿子一定会没事的。”罗梅兰安慰道。
房间内，萧叶坐在床上，思绪一片混乱，想起柳依依，他内心一阵刺疼。
多年的执念，被现实碾成粉碎，但青梅竹马的感情，又岂是朝夕可以忘记的？
他的脑海中，柳依依往昔依偎在他怀中，惹人怜爱、楚楚动人的模样依次出现，但最后都被柳依依清冷绝情的模样所取代。
心痛，无比的心痛！
痛苦的感觉，如同潮水一波波的袭来，几乎让他窒息了。
在村长家的时候，他还能将这种痛苦压在心底，但现在，再也压制不住了。
他想大吼发泄这种痛苦，但是为了不让门外的爹娘担心，他只能死死的咬紧牙关，不让自己发出声响。
因为大力，牙关之间渗出一丝凄凉的血迹，从嘴角缓缓流下。
萧叶表情凄惨，大口呼吸着，并且用手狠狠抓住心口，似乎这样才能缓解疼痛。
突然，萧叶吐出一口鲜血，他在白袍少年赵乾强大的气势压迫下，原本就受了伤，再加上现在情绪剧烈波动，伤势发作了。
望着地上的鲜血，萧叶眼神变得森然起来。
那个带给他屈辱，逼迫他下跪的高傲少年，他想要亲手将其击败，讨回自己的尊严！
他想要让所有看不起他的人，为自己的行为后悔！
“但我的实力……”萧叶的双手微微颤抖着。
冷静下来后，他为现状感到无力。
赵乾是高高在上的先天境武者，有重阳门的栽培，而他却是个连后天境都没踏入的山野少年，两者之间的鸿沟，足够让人绝望。

“我不甘心！”萧叶脸上带着倔强，跳下床在房间内练习拳法。
就算那条鸿沟再大，他也要生生踏平。
这一刻，他对力量的渴望，达到了顶峰。
萧叶不知疲倦的练习着猛虎拳，与此同时，因为情绪的波动，他心脏剧烈的跳动着，很快就超过了正常水准。
嘭嘭嘭！
他的心脏跳动越来越快，最后如同打鼓一般。
“糟了，那怪病又要发作了！”萧叶被惊醒过来，顿时表情一变。
那怪病发作之前的征兆，就是心脏跳动剧烈无比。
“这样也好，怪病发作，我的修炼速度将大增。”萧叶放松下来，等待着怪病的发作。
很快，萧叶便感觉到了一丝不对劲，因为这次心脏跳动比前几次更为剧烈。
就在萧叶有些忐忑之时，一股撕裂的疼痛蓦然袭来，让他身躯狂颤，继而发出痛苦的大叫，眼前一黑，昏迷过去。
恍惚间，他看到一座霞光万丈的小塔，自他胸口破出。
“难道我的怪病，是因为这座小塔导致的？”萧叶脑海闪现这个念头后，意识便被无边的黑暗吞没。
待萧叶再次睁开双眼时，他便震惊的发现，他居然出现在一片星云环绕的空间内。那些星云不断的破灭、新生，仿佛经历一个轮回，绚丽而凄美。
“吾为时间主宰，受亿万生灵朝拜，但天道轮回，却也有陨落的一天……”苍凉的叹息，穿越无垠虚空，在空间内回荡。
什么人！
萧叶心神震荡，环视四周，却没有发现任何人影。
“时间之塔摹刻吾部分时间大道，小家伙，能获得此物，真的很幸运。”一道被雾霭笼罩的影子从虚空走出，融入萧叶的身体。
一道意念涌向他的脑海，传递着信息。
良久，萧叶才睁开双眼，脸上浮现着浓郁的惊骇。

“小家伙，努力吧……”那道意念像是耗尽了力量，化作点点星光，消散在虚空中。
根据这道意念传递的信息显示，他现在身处小塔内部。
这座小塔，名为时间之塔，是时间主宰炼制出来的，共分为五层。
第一层，时间流速比外界慢十倍。
第二层，时间流速比外界慢二十倍。
以此类推，第五层，时间流速比外界慢五十倍。
但关于那位时间主宰的来历，那道意念传递的信息却没有丝毫透露。
“真灵大陆，居然还有这等奇宝！”萧叶喃喃道，到现在他的心绪还无法平复下来，因为这一切太震撼了，他还从未听说过，有控制时间的宝物。

content_en:
Henry Zhang and Luo Meilan were sitting in the hall, looking worriedly at the closed door. Since Xiao Ye returned from the village chief's house, he has locked himself in the room for an hour.
"Alas, Ye'er seems to be strong, but this incident has hurt him too much." Henry Zhang said.
As a father, he knew Xiao Ye's feelings for Liu Yiyi very well.
"Brother Yang, our son will be fine." Luo Meilan comforted.
In the room, Xiao Ye sat on the bed, his thoughts in confusion. Thinking of Liu Yiyi, he felt a tingling pain in his heart.
Years of obsession have been crushed by reality, but how can the feelings of childhood sweethearts be forgotten day and night?
In his mind, Liu Yiyi's lovable and charming looks appeared one after another when she was nestled in his arms, but in the end they were replaced by Liu Yiyi's cold and heartless look.
Heartache, extremely heartache!
The painful feeling came in waves, almost suffocating him.
When he was at the village chief's house, he could still suppress this pain in his heart, but now, he could no longer suppress it.
He wanted to yell to vent the pain, but in order not to worry his parents outside the door, he could only grit his teeth and prevent himself from making any sound.
Because of the strong force, a trace of miserable blood seeped out between his teeth and slowly flowed from the corner of his mouth.
Xiao Ye looked miserable, breathing heavily and clutching his heart with his hands, as if this could relieve the pain.
Suddenly, Xiao Ye spat out a mouthful of blood. Under the pressure of the strong momentum of the white-robed boy Zhao Qian, he was originally injured. Coupled with the violent mood swings now, the injury broke out.
Looking at the blood on the ground, Xiao Ye's eyes became serious.
He wanted to defeat the arrogant young man who brought him humiliation and forced him to kneel down with his own hands and regain his dignity!
He wants to make everyone who looks down on him regret their actions!
"But my strength..." Xiao Ye's hands were trembling slightly.
After calming down, he felt powerless for the current situation.
Zhao Qian is a high-ranking Xiantian realm warrior who has been cultivated by the Chongyang Sect, but he is a young man in the mountains who has never even stepped into the acquired realm. The gap between the two is enough to make people despair.
"I'm not willing to give in!" Xiao Ye had a stubborn look on his face and jumped out of bed to practice boxing in the room.
No matter how big the gap was, he would still have to overcome it in his lifetime.
At this moment, his desire for power reached its peak.
Xiao Ye practiced Tiger Fist tirelessly. At the same time, due to his emotional fluctuations, his heart beat violently, and soon exceeded the normal level.
Bang bang bang!
His heart beat faster and faster, until it was like beating a drum.
"Oops, that strange disease is about to attack again!" Xiao Ye was woken up and his expression suddenly changed.
The sign before the onset of the strange disease is that the heart beats extremely violently.
"That's fine. If the strange disease occurs, my cultivation speed will be greatly increased." Xiao Ye relaxed and waited for the strange disease to occur.
Soon, Xiao Ye felt something was wrong, because this time his heart beat more violently than the previous times.
Just when Xiao Ye was a little worried, a tearing pain suddenly hit him, causing his body to tremble wildly, and then he screamed in pain, his vision went dark, and he passed out.
In a daze, he saw a small tower with brilliant rays of light bursting out of his chest.
"Could my strange illness be caused by this small tower?" After this thought flashed in Xiao Ye's mind, his consciousness was swallowed up by boundless darkness.
When Xiao Ye opened his eyes again, he was shocked to find that he actually appeared in a space surrounded by nebulae. Those nebulae are constantly destroyed and reborn, as if they are going through reincarnation, gorgeous and poignant.
"I am the master of time and am worshiped by hundreds of millions of living beings. However, despite the reincarnation of heaven, I will one day perish..." A desolate sigh traveled through the boundless void and echoed in the space.
Who!
Xiao Ye's mind was shaken and he looked around, but he didn't find anyone.
"timeThe tower imitates part of my time path. Little guy, I am really lucky to get this thing. "A shadow shrouded in mist walked out of the void and merged into Xiao Ye's body.
A thought came to his mind, conveying a message.
After a long time, Xiao Ye opened his eyes, with a strong look of horror on his face.
"Little guy, work hard..." The thought seemed to have exhausted its power and turned into little stars, dissipating in the void.
According to the information transmitted by this thought, he is now inside the small tower.
This small tower, called the Tower of Time, was refined by the Lord of Time and is divided into five floors.
On the first level, time flows ten times slower than the outside world.
On the second level, time flows twenty times slower than the outside world.
By analogy, on the fifth level, the flow of time is fifty times slower than the outside world.
But regarding the origin of the time master, the information conveyed by that thought did not reveal the slightest bit.
“There are such rare treasures in the True Spirit Continent! "Xiao Ye murmured. He still can't calm down because all this is so shocking. He has never heard of a treasure that can control time.
